title: libgphoto2 through 2.5.34 contains a stack buffer overflow in sierra_get_string_register() that lets a malicious…
description: A stack buffer overflow vulnerability exists in libgphoto2 up to version 2.5.34 in the sierra_get_string_register() function. This flaw allows a malicious Sierra-protocol camera or USB device to send an oversized packet when listing files, overwriting stack memory by up to 32 KB. This can lead to crashes or potentially remote code execution.
